name: on_tick
title: time.on_tick
lead: Calls `fn` every tick, 20 times a second, with the tick number; keep it short.

usedIn.quote: time.on_tick(function(tick) end) -> connection   -- 20 times a second; keep it short
Use `time.on_tick` for work tied to world ticks. The actual wait may be longer
- It covers `time.on_tick`, `time.every` and the survival events
